cluster_summary: Moving the rating bounds from .min()/.max() into a .refine() hides them from the JSON-Schema emitter, so UpdateAssetDto/AssetBulkUpdateDto.rating publish minimum/maximum ±9007199254740991 in the OpenAPI spec and generated Dart client instead of a bounded range.
rationale: Moving the bounds into .refine() leaves z.int()'s safe-integer bag min/max as the only emitted bounds, so the spec and generated clients publish minimum -9007199254740991 / maximum 9007199254740991 for the rating field; this is exactly thread 1's 'wrong/misleading' comment on that spec line.
thread_body: This is wrong/misleading. Is there a way to opt out of these values while still using int validation?
